$comment: Dex-written content for the TNG era (#641), merged over the mod's text by pipeline/dexpipe/content.py. "auto" fields are derived from the ship's own weapons, abilities and research.

brg_TNG_constructionship.source: Dimensions measured from the brg_TNG_constructionship model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

description.summary: A drone-crewed work craft that mines, salvages wrecks and repairs damaged vessels, adding everything it gathers to the Collective.

brg_TNG_constructor1.source: Dimensions measured from the brg_TNG_resourcecollector model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

description.summary: Borg vessel, Starfleet designation Type-05 'Interceptor'. A small, fast ship that runs down fleeing targets and holds them for the larger vessels to assimilate.

The octahedral vessel of the Borg Queen, the heart of the Collective's fleet. It builds and launches new vessels and leads every assimilation in person.
Here the Collective has a voice. The Borg Queen directs her drones from aboard her, and the fleet moves as one around the vessel that carries the Queen.

A local assimilation node, where the Collective gathers the materials of the worlds it absorbs. It builds vessels, docks small craft and processes what the drones bring in, and its warp inhibitor holds enemy fleets back.

brg_TNG_probe.subtitle: Unmanned Sensor Probe
brg_TNG_probe.source: Dimensions measured from the brg_TNG_probe model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

brg_TNG_transwarpgate.source: Dimensions measured from the brg_TNG_transwarpgate model (its DAE, through pipeline/render/dae.py): the ring is 7.3 km across and 6.6 km tall, 591 m deep.

description.summary: An advanced construction facility that builds the Cardassians' most feared weapon: the self-guiding Dreadnought missile.
A Cardassian construction freighter that carries and maintains a flight of Construction Bees, building stations wherever the Union expands.

car_TNG_constructionship.source: Dimensions measured from the car_TNG_constructionship model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

description.summary: A Cardassian work craft that mines, strips wrecks for salvage and repairs damaged ships for the Guard.

car_TNG_constructor1.source: Dimensions measured from the car_TNG_resourcecollector model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

description.summary:
A Keldon-class battleship serving as the flagship of the Cardassian fleet. It builds and launches new warships from its own bays.
A Keldon-class battleship chosen by Central Command to lead the Cardassian Guard. Her commander is trusted with the Union's fleet, and Central Command expects every order she gives to be carried out to the letter.

car_TNG_flagship.source: Memory Beta, CDS Ardryl. Crew: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 136, the Keldon class (approximately 500).

description.summary: The most numerous ship of the resource-strapped Cardassian Union, used to lead fighter squadrons or screen larger warships.
A Hideki flown as a patrol craft, watching the Union's borders alone rather than leading a squadron.

A Nor-class station in the mould of Terok Nor, part ore processor and part military base. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps enemy fleets from jumping in on top of it.
A Cardassian mining bee that strips dilithium from asteroids for the Union, which never has enough of anything.
A Cardassian freighter fitted to refine dilithium in the field, so the Union's ships can be fuelled close to the front instead of waiting on supply runs from home.
A Cardassian shipyard that builds destroyers and light to medium cruisers for the Guard, with a single repair berth.
A Cardassian defence platform that guards a set area against small, fast ships. Best placed in groups.
A civilian research station working for the Dominion. It takes no part in the fighting, but it is worth protecting.
A civilian trading post on the Dominion's side of the border, where cargo comes and goes. It takes no part in the fighting.
A civilian station for refitting and upgrading ships. It takes no part in the fighting.
A Dominion construction freighter that carries and maintains a flight of Construction Bees to build stations in newly taken space.

dom_TNG_constructionship.source: Dimensions measured from the dom_TNG_constructionship model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

description.summary: A Dominion work craft that mines, recovers salvage and repairs damaged ships, so the Founders' fleets never go short.

dom_TNG_constructor1.source: Dimensions measured from the dom_TNG_resourcecollector model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

dom_TNG_embassy.source: Dimensions measured from the dom_TNG_embassy model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

description.summary:
A vast Dominion carrier, over a kilometre long, that leads the fleet and builds and launches new ships from its bays. Polaron beams cover it while the ships it launches do the fighting.
The Founders' will, carried into the Alpha Quadrant. The Vorta who commands her speaks for the Dominion, and the Jem'Hadar she carries will fight to the last for the ship that holds their orders.
An Interdictor-class base securing a Dominion foothold in the Alpha Quadrant. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor locks down the space around it.
A fixed Dominion polaron battery, deadly to small craft. Best placed in groups.
A Dominion support ship that repairs damaged vessels in the field and keeps the Jem'Hadar fleet in fighting condition.
A Dominion mining bee that gathers dilithium from asteroids to supply the Founders' fleets in the Alpha Quadrant.
A Dominion dilithium freighter that refines fuel at the asteroid fields and maintains its own flight of mining bees.
A Dominion shipyard that builds attack ships and lighter cruisers and repairs one ship at a time.
A massive Dominion starbase that controls a whole sector: shipyard, resource depot and command post in one.
A fixed Dominion torpedo launcher built to break up capital ships. Best placed in groups.
The orbital offices of a colonial government. A civilian station that takes no part in the fighting.
A civilian trading post serving Federation colonies, where cargo comes and goes. It takes no part in the fighting.
A civilian orbital station handling the traffic of a busy colony. It takes no part in the fighting.
A one-off development of the Prometheus design, carrying quantum torpedoes and a hangar of its own. It only appears on 28 July.
A Starfleet construction freighter that carries and maintains a flight of Construction Bees, so new stations can go up far from any yard.
A modern automated work craft that mines, salvages wrecks and repairs damaged ships wherever Starfleet needs it.

fed_TNG_constructor1.source: Dimensions measured from the fed_TNG_constructor model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

description.summary: A Peregrine-class attack fighter, launched in numbers from carriers to harass larger ships with pulse phasers.

fed_TNG_fighter.source: Memory Alpha, Peregrine class (the Federation attack fighter). Crew: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 68 (Memory Alpha gives one).

description.summary:
The Sovereign-class Enterprise-E, flagship of the Federation. Built with the Borg in mind, she carries quantum torpedoes and some of Starfleet's strongest phaser arrays, and builds and launches new ships from her bays.
Captain Picard's Enterprise, built for a galaxy that had met the Borg. She is the Federation's flagship, and when Starfleet must make a stand, she is the ship it sends.

fed_TNG_flagship.source: Memory Alpha, USS Enterprise (NCC-1701-E): crew of 855.

description.summary: A Regula II-class outpost, the modern successor to Starfleet's frontier bases. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps enemy fleets from jumping in on top of it.
A Starfleet phaser platform that guards a set area against small ships. Best placed in groups to cover each other.
A warship from Starfleet's future, armed with advanced phaser arrays and quantum torpedoes.
An unmanned Starfleet sensor probe that relays data from an area of space without risking a ship or crew.
A Starfleet engineering support ship that projects power onto allied shields and carries the parts and crews to repair damage in the field.
A modern Starfleet mining bee that cuts dilithium from asteroids and ferries it to the nearest freighter or outpost for processing.
A Starfleet dilithium freighter that refines fuel in the field and carries and maintains its own flight of mining bees.
A Starfleet shipyard for escorts, destroyers and light to medium cruisers, with one berth for repairs.
A huge orbital spacedock that builds and repairs whole fleets, stores resources and protects the space around it with a warp inhibitor.
A fixed Starfleet photon torpedo launcher for holding off capital ships. Best placed in groups.
A Starfleet carrier that launches squadrons of strike craft from its hangars, backed by pulse phasers and quantum torpedoes.
A Ferengi marauder, more trader than warship. It carries no weapons in this fleet, and would rather buy its way out of a fight than shoot.

fer_TNG_dkora.source: Memory Alpha, D'Kora class. Crew: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 16.

description.summary: A civilian orbital station handling the traffic of a Klingon world. It takes no part in the fighting.
An orbital depot that rearms and resupplies the Empire's warships.
A civilian trading post where Klingon merchants do business. It takes no part in the fighting.
A work craft that repairs the Defence Force's ships and builds new stations and subsystems wherever the fleet fights.
A light Klingon gunship, fast and cheap. Good at reconnaissance and diversions, and in numbers able to wear down much larger ships.

The Negh'Var, flagship of the Klingon Defence Force and the largest warship in the Empire. It can cloak, and it builds and launches new warships from its own bays.
Chancellor Gowron's flagship, and the largest warship the Empire has ever built. To serve aboard her is the highest honour the Defence Force can give, and when she leads, the whole Empire is watching.

kng_TNG_flagship.source: Memory Alpha, Negh'Var class. Crew: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 47.

description.summary: A Ty'Gokor-class outpost, named for the fortress of the Klingon High Command. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps enemy fleets from jumping in on top of it.
A fixed Klingon disruptor battery that tears into small ships. Best placed in groups.
A Klingon support ship that keeps warriors in the fight, boosting allied shields and repairing battle damage on the spot.
A decommissioned warship stripped of its guns and refitted to process dilithium at the front, with its own flight of mining bees.
A Defence Force shipyard that builds birds-of-prey and lighter cruisers and repairs one ship at a time.
A great Imperial starbase: shipyard, resource depot and fortress in one, with a warp inhibitor to protect the space around it.
A fixed Klingon torpedo launcher that hits large ships hard. Best placed in groups.
The orbital offices of a Romulan colonial administration. A civilian station that takes no part in the fighting.
A Romulan civilian research station. It takes no part in the fighting, though the Tal Shiar takes a close interest in its work.
A civilian trading dock where cargo comes and goes. It takes no part in the fighting.
A Romulan work craft that mines, salvages wrecks and repairs damaged ships for the Star Navy.

The Valdore, Commander Donatra's warbird and flagship of the Romulan fleet. It can cloak, and it builds and launches new ships from its own bays.
Commander Donatra's warbird, which fought beside the Enterprise against the Scimitar. She leads a Star Empire rebuilding itself after Shinzon, and her commander's word carries the weight of the new government.
A Tal'Kratha-class outpost holding a corner of the Star Empire. It builds ships, docks small craft and takes in mined dilithium, and its warp inhibitor keeps intruders from jumping in unannounced.
A fixed Romulan disruptor battery that guards a set area against small ships. Best placed in groups.
A Romulan support ship that reinforces allied shields with its own power and repairs damage away from the yards.
A Romulan mining bee that gathers dilithium for the Star Navy, working the asteroid fields close to the fleet.
A Romulan mining freighter that refines dilithium in the field and keeps a flight of mining bees working around it.
A Romulan shipyard that builds the Star Navy's lighter warbirds and repairs one ship at a time.
A great Romulan stardock: shipyard, resource depot and fortress in one, with a warp inhibitor to protect the space around it.
A fixed Romulan torpedo launcher for holding off capital ships. Best placed in groups.
A living ship of Species 8472, grown rather than built. Its organic hull heals itself, and its fluidic weapons can cripple a starship in a few shots.

und_TNG_nicor.source: Memory Alpha, Species 8472 bio-ship. Crew: Eaglemoss Official Starships Collection issue 43, the Species 8472 bioship.

description.summary: A Voth city ship, nearly ten kilometres long: a whole society in transwarp-capable space. It builds and repairs the Voth fleet and can swallow smaller vessels whole.

vth_TNG_citadel.source: Memory Alpha, Voth city ship (VOY "Distant Origin").

zzz_TNG_crystallineentity.subtitle: Cosmozoan

description.summary: A vast spaceborne lifeform shaped like a snowflake of crystal. It strips worlds of life and can turn its energy on any ship that comes too close.

zzz_TNG_crystallineentity.source: Memory Alpha, Crystalline Entity. Dimensions measured from the zzz_TNG_crystalline (converted from its DAE) model (pipeline/render/measure.py).

kng_TNG_suqjagh.source: Also aboard: A best guess, scaled from the Janissary's 125 crew and 375 marines; the mod gives no figure.

dom_TNG_assault.source: Also aboard: A best guess, scaled from the Janissary's 125 crew and 375 marines; the mod gives no figure.
